founderStory.title: Built by an Expat, for Expats
founderStory.story: After moving abroad and getting hit with hidden bank fees on every transfer home, I realized something had to change. Traditional banks were taking advantage of people who didn't know better, charging inflated exchange rates and burying fees in fine print. I built Remit-Scout to shine a light on the real costs and help expats like you keep more of your hard-earned money.
founderStory.author: Omar Ghabyen

bankVsSpecialist.title: Why Your Bank Charges More (And How to Pay Less)
bankVsSpecialist.subtitle: Banks don't just charge fees, they make most of their money through the exchange rate markup. Here's what you need to know.

bankMarkup.title: How Banks Hide Fees
bankMarkup.description: When you send ${amount} abroad, your bank shows a "low fee" but marks up the exchange rate by 3-5%. That markup is pure profit, invisible unless you compare to the mid-market rate.
bankMarkup.example: If the real {pair} rate is 18.50, a bank might offer you 18.00, pocketing the {difference} on every dollar you send.
bankMarkup.impact: On a {transfer}, that {markup} alone costs you {cost}, before any stated fees. Most customers never notice this "hidden tax."

specialists.title: Why Specialists Win
specialists.description: Money transfer specialists (like Wise, Remitly, Western Union) focus only on remittances, so they've built infrastructure to offer better rates and lower fees. They're often 3–7x cheaper than banks.
specialists.benefits: Many specialists offer same-day or instant delivery, cash pickup options, and mobile wallet deposits, features most banks don't provide.
